description: A CSS stylesheet defining style tokens, utility classes, and layout components for a web application, including color, typography, buttons, containers, and responsive adjustments.

classes.name: typo-55
classes.description: Typography style for heading 1, Poppins font, bold, centered, white color.

classes.name: typo-56
classes.description: Typography style for heading 2, responsive size, centered, white, with pre-line white space handling.

classes.name: typo-57
classes.description: Typography style for body text, Poppins font, regular weight, centered, white.

classes.name: typo-58
classes.description: Typography style similar to typo-57 but potentially for secondary use, centered, white.

classes.name: btn-primary
classes.description: Primary button style with background color, border radius, padding, flex layout, and focus outline.

classes.name: home-indicator
classes.description: Stylized bottom home indicator shape with rounded ends, white background.

classes.name: screen-frame
classes.description: Container with relative positioning, responsive size, overflow hidden, and no border radius for full-bleed layout.

classes.name: screen-bg
classes.description: Background layer covering entire screen area, with cover background size and centered image.

classes.name: status-bar
classes.description: Simulated status bar with centered time, dark mode visuals, and shadow for visibility.

classes.name: safe-bottom
classes.description: Safe area container at the bottom for home indicator spacing.

classes.name: visually-hidden
classes.description: Accessibility utility class for visually hidden content.
